newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks up in thin trade by lunch break.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks up in thin trade by lunch break.

text.p: Thai stocks staged a Christmas rally by the lunch break on Wednesday as local investors sought bargains after the market's heavy losses this month, brokers said.

The SET index moved in the positive territory throughout the morning session, rising 8.60 points or 1.04 percent to 835.32 by the break on thin 1.08 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index gained 0.80 point to 62.49.
"Local investors were active. Regional market closure kept foreign investors away," said Virat Tippanontakul of First Asia Securities.
Brokers attributed the morning rally to short-term speculative buying after the market's composite index retreated almost 450 points this year.
They said the advance was also partly due to window dressing of year-end corporate balance sheets by listed firms.
Krung Thai Bank topped the morning active list, gaining 1.50 baht to 53, Dhana Siam rose three to 66, and Lanna Lignite advanced six to 230.
